name: xsum-MIA-Benchmark
description: A benchmark built on the XSum summarization dataset designed to evaluate models on summarization tasks with an emphasis on membership inference / privacy evaluation. It provides examples and attack labels to measure whether a summarization model leaks training-set membership or other private information. The benchmark is used to quantify model susceptibility to privacy attacks while preserving the summarization task context.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented benchmark used in privacy and security studies to evaluate membership inference on summarization models; limited but growing adoption in the privacy community.
